shortDescription: Dashboard home view rendered in its default state.
fullDescription: Renders the dashboard-home view in its default state and keeps the route implementation on src/app/page.tsx. The view currently presents a GitHub-style dashboard layout with a dark header, profile sidebar, repository cards, contribution heatmap, and contribution activity areas while exposing a state prop for future supported states.

shortDescription: Protected reference workspace with authenticated template examples.
fullDescription: Renders a protected reference workspace that demonstrates the application's authenticated shell, data fetching examples, storage upload controls, theme toggle, and reusable UI primitives. It remains separate from generated product views and serves as a working catalog of template capabilities.
